docs.summary: Fluent builder for an unwrap call. Construct with positions + triangles, optionally chain [`WithNormals`](#api~Prowl.Unwrapper.UnwrapMesh~WithNormals) and [`WithMaterialUVs`](#api~Prowl.Unwrapper.UnwrapMesh~WithMaterialUVs), then call [`Unwrap`](#api~Prowl.Unwrapper.UnwrapMesh~Unwrap). Triangles are flat unsigned indices (three per triangle). Per-corner UVs, if provided, are 3 × triangleCount Double2 values — they are only used as a hint when welding vertices.

params.triangles: Flat triangle list: indices into `positions`, three per face.

docs.summary: Per-vertex normals. Used as a welding guard — coincident points with opposing normals are kept apart.
Per-corner material UVs (three per triangle). Disagreement across an edge gets marked as a UV seam during segmentation, which biases chart growth to follow existing seams.
Receive per-phase progress messages (cleanup, segmentation, parametrisation, packing). Handy while diagnosing slow unwraps; ignored when null.
Run the unwrap with the supplied options.

members.name: Unwrap
members.signature: public static UnwrapResult Unwrap(Double3[] positions, int[] triangles, UnwrapOptions? options = null)

docs.summary: One-shot convenience: equivalent to `new UnwrapMesh(positions, triangles).Unwrap(options)`.
